values.quote: leaving behind a {{tip|clone}} of himself at his casting position for 4 seconds

mechanics.claim: The clone can basic attack autonomously, prioritizing the last enemy Wukong damaged, and deals reduced damage scaled by CloneDamageMod.
mechanics.quote: The clone is {{tip|untargetable}} to allies and can basic attack autonomously, prioritizing the last enemy '''Wukong''' damaged.

mechanics.claim: The clone can gain the effects of Crushing Blow and Nimbus Strike's bonus attack speed, and casts Cyclone whenever Wukong does.
mechanics.quote: It can also gain the effects of ''{{ai|Crushing Blow|Wukong}}'' and ''{{ais|Nimbus Strike|Wukong}}'' {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}, and casts ''{{ai|Cyclone|Wukong}}'' whenever '''Wukong''' does.

mechanics.claim: Casting Warrior Trickster during an ability's effects transfers them to the clone.
mechanics.quote: Casting ''Warrior Trickster'' during an ability's effects will transfer them to the clone.

mechanics.claim: Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the end of the attack windup.
mechanics.quote: Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the end of the attack windup.

mechanics.claim: Wukong dashes in the target direction and can cast any of his abilities during the dash.
mechanics.quote: '''Wukong''' can cast any of his [[champion ability|abilities]] during the dash.
